name: Manipulation of View
summary: Adversaries may attempt to manipulate the information reported back to operators or controllers. This manipulation may be short term or sustained. During this time the process itself could be in a much different state than what is reported. Operators may be fooled into doing something that is harmful to the system in a loss of view situation.
